## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My commits follow the conventional-commits style used in the repo.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally, including the post-build assertions.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for any new user-facing behavior.
- [ ] I updated the README(s) if this changes providers, formats, or user-visible workflow.
- [ ] I updated CHANGELOG.md under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] This PR does not weaken any build assertion in `scripts/build.mjs` without prior discussion.
- [ ] This PR does not add a new host permission without also updating the manifest and build assertions.
